The '''Praelions'''<ref name="TAVG" /> were a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]],<ref name="The Acolyte" /> specifically from the [[Japrael sector]]. [[Axut Klem]] was a member of this species.<ref name="TAVG" />

==Biology and appearance==
The Praelions were a bipedal [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that were distinguished by their [[Color|dark]] skin that was covered in a series of uniformed bumps, as well as a slightly enlarged [[Bone|cranium]], pointed [[ear]]s, and dark and light [[hair]].<ref name="The Acolyte" />

==Species in the galaxy==
By [[132 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TheAcolyteDate}}</ref> a member of this species, [[Axut Klem]], served as a [[senator]] for the [[Japrael sector]].<ref name="TAVG" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
The Praelions species made their debut in the [[The Acolyte (episode)|eighth episode]] of the [[2024]] television series, ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', directed by [[Hanelle M. Culpepper]].<ref name="The Acolyte" /> Their name was revealed within the ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]''<ref name="TAVG" /> which released in select countries on [[June 5]], [[2025]].<ref name="DK UK">{{DK|url=uk/book/9780241710425-star-wars-the-acolyte-visual-guide|text=Star Wars The Acolyte Visual Guide}}</ref>
